evidence.quote: Indeed, the inflation picture is less favorable than it appeared earlier this year.
Altogether, the incoming data would suggest a somewhat higher inflation rate for this year and stronger economic growth.
On the one hand, if tighter financing conditions restrain the economy, the appropriate path of the federal funds rate may be lower than it would be in their absence.
On the other hand, if data show continued strength in the economy and slower disinflation, we may have more work to do.
However, I am closely watching developments in the banking sector, which have the potential to tighten credit conditions and counteract some of that momentum.
We shifted from anticipating "ongoing increases" to saying that "some additional policy firming may be appropriate."

parsed.rationale: Inflation and activity are described as persistent and strong, but banking-sector headwinds and endorsement of softened guidance leave the policy path balanced between possibly lower rates and more tightening. The net signal is roughly neutral with a slight hawkish tilt from the inflation discussion.
